title: Joint application of Bonanza Bus Lines, Inc. of Prrovidence, Rhode Island (proposed Transferee) and Peter Pan Bus Lines, Inc. of Springfield, Massachusetts (Poposed Transferor) and Peter Pan Bus Lines, Inc., of Springfield, Massachusetts (proposed Transferee) for approval by the Department of Public Utilties, under the provisions of Section 7A of Chapter 159A of the Generals Laws. as amended, of the transfer of a certificate of public convenience and necessity No. 3755-B, authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over routes in the Cites and Towns of Worcester, Boylston, Shrewsbury, Northboro, Marlboro, Southboro, Framingham, Natick, Massachusetts Turnpike and Boston.
